destinations.title: CFT criteria for perturbatively local AdS EFT
destinations.question: Which properties of CFT data permit a perturbative local AdS effective theory with a cutoff parametrically above the curvature scale?
destinations.summary: Isolates the three-part locality criterion from broader questions about gravitational duals, interaction exclusions and compactification hierarchies.

systems: CFT data proposed to describe a perturbative local AdS EFT
targets: An EFT cutoff parametrically above curvature
assumptions: The announced criterion combines a perturbative expansion, an approximate Fock space with finitely many low-dimension generators, and polynomially bounded Mellin behavior.
The source's necessity and sufficiency claim is not independently proved here.
conventions: A gravitational dual need not admit a finite-field local EFT.
A cutoff above curvature is distinct from a compactification mass gap.
includes: The criterion as a question about applicability of a controlled bulk description
excludes: Identification of the separate higher-spin interaction restrictions with the locality criterion

destinations.title: Damping admissible inflationary excitations
destinations.question: How rapidly does inflation suppress observable consequences of initial quantum excitations that are compatible with the EFT and already support the inflationary regime?
destinations.summary: Separates conditional loss of initial-state memory from the probability of starting inflation and from environmental decoherence.

systems: Inflationary quantum excitations in a controlled EFT
regimes: Weakly coupled EFT treatment of admissible initial states
assumptions: The damping claim concerns surviving EFT-admissible states that already support inflation.
Admissibility and support of the background are conditions, not outcomes established for arbitrary initial states.
conventions: Loss of observable excitation is distinct from environmental decoherence.
A damping timescale does not determine the probability that inflation begins.
includes: Conditional persistence or suppression of observable initial-state memory
excludes: Generic-state survival or inflationary onset probabilities
